relationship_description: Albert Raymond Garcia is the son of Tet Garcia, former governor and congressman of Bataan, both part of the Garcia political dynasty in Bataan.
Albert Raymond Garcia and Joet Garcia are brothers, both sons of Tet Garcia, and members of the Garcia political dynasty in Bataan.
Al Francis Bichara is the father-in-law of Edcel Greco Lagman, connecting the Bichara and Lagman political dynasties in Albay.
